title: MSIT
description: Re-designed grievance portal improving UI/UX of the portal adding tabular data, diagrams and piecharts for better data visualization interpretation.
Improved loading speed between pages of the grievance portal by identifying a vulnerability introduced due to use of Next.js middleware dependent routing.
Improved scalability by introducing a fresh database architecture, which prevents potential DDOS attacks as well.

title: Non-blocking HTTP server in C
description: Worked on upgrading FinnOne for General Motors which is one of the flagship products of the company made using Java8 & SpringBoot.
